CH*EPO.note: 0/324 deterministic direct prices. Exhaustive current public-path analysis completed: official QR route is decoded and Eponet Go APK exposes production api.eponet.io plus ocpp/rate/getrates/, but map/detail/rate APIs return 403 without account authentication and current QR URLs use opaque 32-hex tokens. 8 Charger IDs covering 23 current EVSEs are known, but no current-snapshot public-charge token was found in indexed QR files/photos or public directories.
